title: M6 · The shared count cards
intro: One row of count cards for every roster, as the design review decided (rulebook v1.013, v1.014): tapping a card filters the list; a money total (“Payments recorded”) stays a total and can't be tapped; the tapped card gets the blue edge; two by two on phones. Each section passes its own cards. Amber outline = what the shared row decides. One detail to OK — Black Belt on phones (6): today Black Belt's phones show two pills, “Late 2” and “Not paid 1”, instead of cards (v0.219). With the shared row they get the same 2×2 cards as every other roster — v1.013 says “the same look and tap behaviour”, and a pill mode would be a second look to keep. If you OK it, the new row records that it changes v0.219. Every state at all four sizes: M6-count-cards.png.

footer: What changes for each section when it switches (later, in its own prompt): Color Belt's private testing cards start filtering (v1.013) · Star's Payments recorded stops being tappable and its selected card gets the blue edge, not a dark one · Camps' summary line becomes its four cards (v1.014) · Black Belt's phones get the 2×2 cards (the detail above). Finance's report cards stay as they are.
